item.title: 20-Minute Outdoor Learning Activity: Schoolyard Biodiversity Detectives
item.description: A free 20-minute outdoor learning activity for primary school: compare two safe school-ground habitats, record biodiversity clues and discuss evidence. Includes materials, timings and safety guidance.
